description: The figure is a donut-style pie chart summarizing the distribution of “Task Type” in the referenced study, showing 2 slices in total. The larger slice is labeled “Article generation (83.2%)” and is colored salmon/red, occupying a bit over four-fifths of the ring. The remaining slice is labeled “Headline” and is colored pale yellow, occupying the remaining roughly one-sixth (about 16.8%). The chart places the title “Task Type” in bold at the center of the donut, uses direct text labels near the slices (with the percentage explicitly shown for Article generation), includes no separate legend, and does not show any exploded or offset segments; the slices appear arranged with the larger segment spanning most of the circle and the smaller segment grouped on the right side.
